metadata.title: Harmonic maps from spheres with lowest possible index and their properties
metadata.abstract: In this note, we prove that for n > 2 a harmonic map $\mathbb{S}^n \to \mathbb{CP}^m$, of index n+1 is pseudo horizontally weakly conformal, that $n$ must be odd. In particular, for even n every non-constant harmonic map $\mathbb{S}^n \to \mathbb{CP}^m$ has index at least n+2. We also present a harmonic map from $\mathbb{S}^4$ to $\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(2,4)$ of index 5 that is not pseudo horizontally weakly conformal, so the statement does not extend to Grassmannians.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 最低指标调和映射的刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对 n>2，从 Sn 到 CPm 的指标 n+1 调和映射证明伪水平弱共形且 n 必奇；偶 n 的非平凡映射指标至少 n+2，并给出 S4 到 Grassmannian 的反例。
analysis.breakthrough: 精确识别最低指标刚性及目标空间变化后的失效。
analysis.limitations: 结论依赖复射影目标，不能推广到一般 Grassmannian。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 5.6 协助找到第 3 节构造反例所用的映射及参考文献；全部计算由作者完成，最终文字结构和校对另由生成式 AI 辅助。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.35589v1 · 第 13 页 Usage of AI
